name: Builder Notes
description: Adds a 'Builder Notes' textarea to config-entity edit forms (field, display, node type, role, image style, etc.) for storing site-builder annotations.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 Allows site builders to keep notes on manage display/manage form and field storage and config settings form.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 Imagine you're building a site.

Three years later you find yourself making changes.

You arrive on the 'teaser' view mode.

You wonder to yourself, hmm, where is this used. If I make changes, what could it break.

But then you remember that three years ago you used the builder notes module.

You click in the tab, and all your notes are there.

You wonder no more.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 Nothing other than field_ui in core.

 Back to top 

 Known problems 
 Please use the issue queue

 Back to top 

 Roadmap 
 Hoping to extend it to all config entities.
